name: Bases View Extract
changes: Several views in separate sections, Save preset and Load preset now show how to get Pro, with a Sponsor on GitHub button. The free preview of one view stays.
tip: Select Copy to clipboard to copy the complete query block with its shared definitions.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases View Extract is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with Bases. Bases is still new, and your setups teach me a lot.
